name: The Train Back
description: A player's small moment on the ride, on a skill they name. It costs nothing on any result.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: Somebody else on the train noticed, in a small, real way.
outcomes.success: It goes fine, and it's theirs.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The kind of thing that's funnier in a week.

notes: A player moment: the player names the skill and tells the result.
